meta.title: Implement register coalescing
meta.body_summary: Implement register coalescing to reduce virtual register usage by eliminating redundant Move ops in the VM optimizer; update IR golden files accordingly.

As a compiler optimization PR with no review, it was self‑closed after 45 hours, consistent with a experimental change that may not have been ready for merge.
